Discovery Merger 12 hours ago See All Getty Zelda Williams is calling for fans to stop circulating AI-generated videos of her late father, Robin Williams , nearly a year after she last took to social media to ask them not to send her augmented content featuring the actor. In a statement posted to X on Monday, the “Lisa Frankenstein” director wrote that a “supposedly ‘private video’” circulating of her father “is clearly AI, and not even particularly convincing AI,” she wrote. “Anyone who claims to be a fan who believes it clearly listened to his movies on mute because that voice is robotic and terrible. That said, a human made a robot create it, and to you I say: leave him out of your delusional bullshit and let him rest. If you cannot make your case without making a dead man make it more convincing for you, then tell me: who’s the one manipulating the public thru media now?” Related Stories Emmys Presenters: Matthew McConaughey, Shailene Woodley and ‘Baywatch’ Reboot Stars Join Lineup
reactions: [Hacker News] > should you do these things? Emphatically yes. Just as freely as you use the words and language of dead people. One day you won't even think about it. Well, your descendants won't. The aversion dies with you.

[Hacker News] > Unfortunately, content creators have no shame FTFY. Otherwise, you're right. A system where the selection pressure happens through money and attention is bound to devolve to appeal to the strongest most primitive of desires.

[Hacker News] Before this article I wasn't even aware but 100% there's going to be a huge increase in Robin Williams AI saying/doing whack shit just like all the other AI footage of famous people. If you are publicly famous, your image no longer is owned by you, especially true with AI now.
[Hacker News] Not necessarily, anonymity enables a lot of interesting behaviors. I see it all the time on HN.
[Hacker News] This lady needs some proper advice on this. She is only digging this hole deeper by feeding it attention.

[Hacker News] Haven't seen the videos, but she seems to complain of videos claiming to be authentic private videos of him stating a particular political message — and of these videos being forwarded to her (possibly for verification?). This has nothing to do with impersonating a deceases person but about rewriting (personal) history she finds shameful.

items.title: Robin Williams' Daughter to Fans Creating AI Videos: 'Have Some Shame'
